title: Meals file
description: Meals the kitchen's Meals List can make. Loaded as mod content type 'meal' (assets/_meals/*.json). Reference: docs/COOKING.md. Checker: tools/meal_format.py. Code: Assets/Scripts/Kitchen/.

name.description: Shown in the list; the result item's name when empty.

group.description: The heading it is listed under (Baking, Grilling, Cooking ...).

container.description: An empty liquid container item (a jar, a bottle) the meal fills.

liquid.description: The liquid it is filled with.

liters.description: How much; 0 or missing = the container's capacity.

result.description: Either an item {item_id, quantity}, or a container filled with a liquid {container, liquid, liters?}: it needs an empty liquid container in the kitchen, which comes back full with what it holds kept.

ingredients.description: The recipe tree (tools/recipe_format.py): lines {item_id (item | #tag | ~equivalency), quantity} and sections {section, mode all|any, if {uses|not_uses}, items}. Consumed from the kitchen's containers and shelves.

appliances.description: Groups of tools; the kitchen needs ANY ONE of each group. Not consumed.
